name: Parsley-leaved Bramble
desc: Parsley-leaved Bramble (Rubus laciniatus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rubus laciniatus, the cutleaf evergreen blackberry or evergreen blackberry, is a European species of Rubus. It is an introduced species elsewhere, often being considered invasive.
